goal: Decide whether a block header carries the work its target asks for, so a node's acceptance can be replayed from the header alone.

app.name: header-work
app.title: Header work
app.purpose: Decide whether a block header is accepted, from the leading zero bits of its double SHA-256 hash, the leading zero bits its target requires, and its version.

fields.name: zeros
fields.means: leading zero bits of the header's sha256d hash

fields.name: target
fields.means: leading zero bits the compact target requires

fields.name: version
fields.means: whether the header version is one the node accepts

rules.why: a stale version is never accepted

limits: Leading zero bits approximate the target comparison; equal zero counts are treated as meeting it.

properties.why: a header without the work is never accepted

stakeholders.name: Node operator
stakeholders.text: Runs a node and needs every accepted header to carry the work its target requires.
